Questions we hear a lot.
How fast can I actually get started?
The scribe and charting side works from day one. You can sign up and see a patient today. Credentialing takes as long as credentialing takes (60 to 120 days depending on the payer), but we start the moment you do, and you keep seeing patients in parallel. Your JotSite website goes live in about 10 business days.
Do you really support e-prescribing?
Yes, including EPCS for controlled substances. We handle the identity proofing, the two-factor setup, and the state-by-state registration paperwork. If you prescribe Schedule II through IV, we get you there.
What if I already have patients on another EHR?
We’ll migrate the charts. Intakes, notes, med lists, problem lists, phone numbers. We handle the export, we handle the import. You don’t lose anything, and you don’t do the work.
Is there a contract or lock-in?
No. The Core subscription is month-to-month. JotBill has a 90-day runway while we stabilize your revenue cycle, and then it’s month-to-month too. If you’re not happy, you leave with all your data, all your notes, and a clean export.
I’m not a psychiatrist or PMHNP. Is this still for me?
Yes. This page was built for solo prescribers in a 1-3 person practice, but JotPsych works for therapists, social workers, and larger clinics too.

Is there a free trial?
+
Yes. Every new user gets a free trial with full access to AI-generated notes. No credit card required to start.
Can I switch plans at any time?
+
Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect at the start of your next billing cycle. There are no long-term contracts required.
What happens if I exceed 15 notes on the Moonlighting plan?
+
You'll be prompted to upgrade to the Basic plan for unlimited notes. Your existing notes and data are always preserved.
How does annual billing work?
+
Annual billing is paid upfront for the year at a discounted rate. You save compared to paying monthly. Cancel anytime and keep access through the end of your billing period.
What is included in the Everything plan?

The Everything plan includes unlimited notes, templates, labs, forms, documents, follow-up emails, personalized AI learning, and audit. Yes. For deployments of 7 or more providers, we offer custom pricing with volume discounts, dedicated onboarding, and a named account manager. Contact sales to discuss your needs.
